text:
reza: quick follow-up from the control-plane separation RFC. thinking about a compact design that supports: short-lived regional anchors, optional in-customer proxy, and an offline bundle flow for air-gapped installs. pros/cons?
anya: short-lived anchors reduce blast radius. main ops headaches: cert rotation, cache warmup, and discovery for private installs.
hugo: for certs: central signer issues short-lived leaf certs to anchors. for air-gapped we add an "offline bundle" the ops team can upload with explicit expiry and serial.
tara: discovery choices: env override -> local registry file/socket -> controlplane registry API -> DNS SRV -> global fallback. SDKs should expose this order and sensible timeouts.
reza: agree. propose default timeouts: local 40ms, registry 120ms, SRV 250ms, global 800ms. clients should prefer same-AZ anchors when available.
anya: streaming note: we need session resume. design: session tokens include anchor_id, issued_at, expiry and a revocation nonce. tokens allow reconnection and incremental KV sync. revoke on handoff.
hugo: handoff semantics: announce DRAIN_START, mirrored writes for N seconds, then DRAIN_COMPLETE. provide a /health?drain=true endpoint that returns 200 until connections < threshold then 503 so LB can move traffic.
tara: cache warmup: prefetch top-N prefixes async. offer a /v1/prefetch API (auth required) that streams progress. make prewarm opt-in for Private to avoid billing surprises.
infra-bot: scheduled: perf spike SRV vs registry next Wed 02:00 UTC
reza: proxy vs direct tradeoff: proxy gives stable egress IPs (good for whitelisting) but adds NAT state and cost. prefer opt-in proxy mode per-customer or per-route.
anya: for private installs, offline bundle revocation is tricky — support bundle serial bump + short grace window. document clock-skew and manual revoke steps for ops.
hugo: metrics/tracing: add anchor_id/relay_id tags, cp.handoff.duration, cp.prefetch.bytes, stream.resume_success. include bundle_serial in trace root when present.
tara: next steps: 1) anya + hugo draft bundle lifecycle doc and revocation flow, 2) rez + tara update SDK discovery + token defaults, 3) infra run SRV vs registry perf spike and measure warmup bandwidth.
reza: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with these decisions and attach bandwidth estimates when infra shares results. leaving thread open for comments.
